manifest.description: Cattle feed inventory and store credit sales
Dynamic FAT/SNF rate slabs and incentives
Double-entry ledger engine and immutability triggers
Farmer bulk payouts, payment batches, and reconciliation
Kiosk shift presets and SFace model seeds
QUARANTINED: Targeted destructive phone number deletion
Central Super Admin platform audit, hardware inventory, AMC, alerts, and bank details
